Tuesday Night Bike Ride from R.T. O'Sullivan's

Scottsdale, AZ · Social

Tuesday Night Bike Ride from R.T. O'Sullivan's is a social group ride in Scottsdale, AZ. It rolls every Tuesday at 7:15 pm from R.T. O'Sullivan's Sports Grill.

For visitors

RSVP on the Meetup event. The ride runs after dark and ends around 9:15 pm, so bring lights. The host posts the route turn by turn on the event page. Meetup shows no fee.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: social ride on bike paths with regroups at Tempe Town Lake Marina, the Priest Road bridge and the Rural Road bridge.. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

About the Tuesday Night Bike Ride from R.T. O'Sullivan's group ride

A Tuesday-night social ride from R.T. O'Sullivan's in Scottsdale. It runs the Scottsdale Greenbelt south to Tempe Town Lake, crosses the lake on the pedestrian bridge by the Tempe Center for the Arts, loops back over the Priest Road and Rural Road bridges, and finishes at the sports grill. The host moved it to 7:15 pm because of the summer heat.
